editorial.name: react-restart/ui
editorial.descriptionZh: Restart UI——一套不给样式的 React 组件，把弹层、焦点陷阱这类状态与交互逻辑封装好，接进任意样式体系都行。文档站是 react-restart.github.io/ui，1.2M 个项目在用它。
editorial.takeawayZh: 装 @restart/ui 拿无样式组件逻辑
editorial.noteZh: README 开头 A set of full featured, extensible, and accessible UI components, designed to integrate into any styling framework or system.，下一段强调 Restart components, are "headless", meaning they don't provide any styles.，并给出 Documentation → https://react-restart.github.io/ui/ 与 npm install --save @restart/ui。提交历史里有一条 feat: Implement modal tab behavior according to current APG recommend…，src 目录下则是 allow passing focus options to focus trap (#134)，能看出它跟着 APG 做键盘行为。About 侧栏却写 No description or website provided.，Topics 是 headless-ui / react / typescript，MIT license、142 stars、1,060 commits、55 位贡献者、Releases 10（最新 v1.6.9）、Used by 1.2M。

reasons.statement: 用户装 @restart/ui 拿走的是无样式组件逻辑，README 明写 headless 与 they don't provide any styles，Topics 也标 headless-ui，故归无样式无障碍原语。
提交记录里的 feat: Implement modal tab behavior according to current APG recommend… 与 src 的 allow passing focus options to focus trap (#134) 都是无障碍交互实现的证据。
